description: This file defines a React component for a note-taking application called 'Modern Notes'. It includes theme constants, state management, UI components for listing, viewing, editing, and deleting notes, and styling. The code manages local storage, supports search, sorting, and theme toggling, and provides a complete frontend interface for note management.
